nodes.label: Ohw, it's Friday already - social media graphic
nodes.author: AD Graphics
nodes.description: Portrait-format (about 1080x1300) promotional/social media poster. A surprised child with puffy braided hair buns, round black glasses and a pink floral blouse with yellow suspenders is cut out and layered over a huge cream condensed 'FRIDAY' headline. Small copy 'ohw, it's' sits above and 'already' below, with yellow brush-stroke accents and cream splash shapes beside the face. A teal 'AD GRAPHICS' pill badge with the ad logo sits at the bottom left.
nodes.rationale: Sample of the kind of playful, culturally local (Ghanaian 'ohw' interjection) engagement post AD Graphics designs; shown in the seed gallery to demonstrate design quality to prospective customers.

nodes.label: AD Graphics teal badge and logo
nodes.description: Teal rounded pill reading 'AD GRAPHICS' in white caps, with the orange/brown 'ad' monogram logo (diamond/ring motif) at its left end, slightly rotated.
nodes.rationale: Acts as the brand signature/watermark so the sample is attributed to AD Graphics.

nodes.label: Oversized FRIDAY condensed headline
nodes.description: Giant cream-white tall condensed sans-serif 'FRIDAY' slightly skewed and partially hidden behind the child's head, supported by small rounded rounded sans 'ohw, it's' and 'already' in pale pink.
nodes.rationale: Scale contrast and subject-over-text layering create depth and make the single word the focal message; the playful lowercase supporting copy gives a conversational tone.

nodes.label: Surprised child portrait cutout
nodes.description: Photo cutout of a young Black girl with wide eyes and open mouth, puffy hair buns with braids, round glasses, pink floral blouse and yellow suspenders; edges feathered into the background.
nodes.rationale: The exaggerated shocked expression embodies the 'it's Friday already' joke, giving an emotional hook and relatable humour that drives social engagement.

nodes.label: Warm peach blurred bokeh background
nodes.description: Textured peach-to-orange gradient with out-of-focus dark and golden blobs at the corners and soft yellow brush-stroke accents.
nodes.rationale: A warm, monochromatic palette makes the cream headline and the skin tones pop and conveys a cheerful, end-of-week mood; blurred corners add depth and direct focus to the centre.

nodes.label: AD Smart landing page seed gallery sample
nodes.description: Role of this image: one of the seeded portfolio/gallery samples shown on the landing page of AD Smart Business Cards (digital/NFC business cards by AD Graphics, Ghana).
nodes.rationale: Showcases AD Graphics' creative design capability as social proof alongside the digital business card product.
